subject: Deployment licensing and support — request for simpler billing
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@healthsync.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:24:00 -0400
Subject: Deployment licensing and support — request for simpler billing

Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's runtime performance. We are preparing an internal ask for private deployment (VPC/on-prem) and our procurement team has a few specific pricing and packaging questions before we proceed:

- Prefer a single invoice structure rather than multiple line-items; can you provide a consolidated quote that bundles licensing + platform fee + optional support?
- We plan to commit for 12 months initially. What discount do you offer for 12-month commits vs month-to-month? Any step pricing for multi-year?
- Clarify support tiers (standard vs premium vs 24x7) and which deliverables are included (SLA credits, on-call RAs, security scanning).
- Migration/onboarding credits: can those be applied to professional services or token usage?
- Payment timing: our finance prefers staged payments tied to milestones. Is that acceptable?

Attached our RFP and a short summary of expected peak QPS and storage for KV cache. Also need SOC2 evidence and basic network requirements for our security team.

Looking for a condensed quote and recommended commercial structure — happy to set a 30-minute call next week.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Director of IT Procurement
HealthSync
[Attachment: HealthSync-RFP-2026.pdf (pdf)]
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Deployment licensing and support — request for simpler billing

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise counterproposal we can convert into a single consolidated quote and SOW. I copied Ben (lead AE) and Marissa (solutions) to align on delivery.

High-level commercial structure (proposal):
- Licensing: perpetual license option or annual subscription. For a 12-month subscription we propose a 15% discount off list license rates. Perpetual + annual maintenance available if you prefer CAPEX treatment; maintenance at 18% year 1.
- Platform fee (applies to private deployment): tiered monthly fee based on capacity band:
  * Band A (dev/staging): $6,000/mo
  * Band B (production small): $18,000/mo
  * Band C (production large): $42,000/mo
- Support tiers (add-on pricing):
  * Standard (business hours, email): included with subscription
  * Premium (24x7 on-call, 1-hour P1 response, quarterly architecture review): +$6,500/mo
  * Enterprise (dedicated TAM, weekly ops sync, on-site as-needed): price on request
- Migration & onboarding credits: we include 40 hours of professional services credit for free with a 12-month commit. Additional hours billed at our partner rate. Credits may be applied to either PS or token credits up to an agreed cap.
- Payment / milestone suggestion: 40% upfront on order, 40% at go-live, 20% 60 days post go-live. We can be flexible on staging to meet your finance preferences.
- Multi-year: additional 7% off for a 24-month commit (stackable with initial discount up to a maximum combined discount of 22%).

Attachments: I am attaching a one-page pricing-breakdown and a short commercial summary. SOC2: Redwood will share our Type II report via secure link once we have an NDA/secure transfer in place (link included below).

Next steps:
1) Review this structure with procurement and security; confirm which platform band maps to expected QPS.
2) If acceptable, we will convert to a formal commercial quote + short SOW and proposed payment schedule.
3) Align on go-live target and any migration windows (we can hold onboarding credits for 90 days).

If helpful, Ben and I can take a 30-minute call Monday to walk procurement through the consolidated quote.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0119
[Attachment: pricing-breakdown-20261002.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Secure SOC2 link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2docs]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 12:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Deployment licensing and support — request for simpler billing

Internal notes / negotiation guidance (for Irene):

- Keep the 15% license discount but hold firm on platform fee bands — customers place higher perceived value on predictable monthly platform fees (gives us stickiness).
- Offer a short 6-month ramp incentive: first two months platform fee at 50% (to ease initial OPEX). That is less margin-impacting than a deeper license cut.
- Migration credits: make them non-refundable but transferable to token credits or additional PS to avoid churn risk. We can flex to make a small portion (e.g., 8 hours) refundable if legal insists.
- Payment terms: accept staged payments but avoid very long tails (>90 days). Finance prefers 40/40/20. If they push for 30/40/30, ask for a slight increase in the platform fee in year 1 (2.5%).
- Support upsell: leave Premium as add-on; attach SLA language that limits credit exposure.

I'll prep a short negotiation playbook prior to the call — keep this internal until we finalize.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@healthsync.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Deployment licensing and support — request for simpler billing

Irene — thank you for the clear proposal and the spreadsheet. HealthSync is generally comfortable with the commercial structure, with a few asks so we can expedite internal approvals:

1) Payment schedule: can we move to 30% upfront, 40% at go-live, 30% 60 days post go-live? This aligns with our internal cashflow.
2) Migration credits: we prefer the option to convert unused credits to token credits or, if unused after 120 days post-go-live, have a partial refund (up to 25% of unused value). Is that possible?
3) SOC2 access: we'll sign the minimal NDA today if you send it and then request the Type II.
4) Can you include a short-term ramp concession on platform fee for months 1–2 (50% as Ben suggested)?

If you can confirm these three items in writing, I can get this to legal/procurement for a PO. Target sign-off: Oct 20.

Thanks — happy to take a quick call if that speeds things up.

Best regards,
Elena Rossi
Director of IT Procurement, HealthSync
[Attachment: HealthSync-PO-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
